CENTRAL POLICE Station.
2nd September 19 20

REPORT ON Daily Report.

Made by D. S. I. Kay Forwarded by a/. Director of Criminal Intelligence.

Sir,

The Peking Cabinet has approved the appointment of Gen.
Wu Pae Fu as Deputy Inspector General of Chihli, Shantung
and Honan.

Yao Tsoh Ping(姚作賓), a prominent member of the
National Students' Union who was reported as having gone
to the North about the middle of August, for the purpose of
interviewing Gen. Wu Pae Fu regarding the establishment of
the National Citizens' Convention, is reported to have
returned to Nanking. It is stated that Yao was successful
in seeing Gen. Wu, and the latter is reported to have sent
a letter (Translation attached) to the local Students' Union dealing with the
National Citizens' Convention. Yao is reported to have
had an interview with Gen. Li Shun at Nanking, and is
expected to return here in the course of the next few days.

A Committee meeting of the National Citizens' Conven-
tion Organization was held at the headquarters of the
Cantonese Guild, No. 11 Ningpo Road, at 5 p.m. yesterday
the 1st instant. Tsz Kyi Yuan(周刻雲), Shantung Road
Street Union presided. It was decided to send telegrams
to all provincial associations urging them to join in the
National Citizens' Convention movement. A meeting of
the Committee will be held tomorrow the 3rd instant, at
which the question of obtaining new premises, suitable as
headquarters of the Organization, will be discussed.

The National Organizations' Union of China (Shanghai
branch), whose headquarters are at No. 5 Zung Yue Li(城裕里)

1920年9月2日

日报报告。

由特别调查员凯（Kay）呈报，经代理刑事情报处处长转呈。

敬启者：

北京内阁已批准任命吴佩孚将军为直隶、山东及河南三省副督察长。

全国学生联合会重要成员姚作賓（Yao Tsoh Ping）据报于八月中旬北上，旨在就召开国民大会一事会晤吴佩孚将军，现据报已返回南京。据悉，姚成功会见了吴将军，且据报吴将军已向当地学生联合会发出一封关于国民大会的信函（附译文）。据报姚在南京会见了李纯将军，预计将于未来数日内返回此地。

国民大会组织委员会于昨日（即本月1日）下午5时，在宁波路11号广东会馆总部召开会议。山东路马路公会主席周刻雲（Tsz Kyi Yuan）主持会议。会议决定向各省协会发送电报，敦促其加入国民大会运动。委员会将于明日（即本月3日）再次开会，讨论租赁适合作为该组织总部的新址事宜。

中华全国各界联合会（上海分会），其总部设于法租界马浪路（Rue Marche）城裕里（Zung Yue Li）5号，

Rue Marche, French Concession, has sent letters to the various
Street Unions and other societies asking them to send repre-
sentatives to a meeting,which will probably be held within
the next few days at the above address,to discuss the National
Citizens' Convention movement.    It is stated that the
members of the National Organizations' Union are opposed
to the National Citizens' Convention Organization which
was formed on the 21st ultimo, and which now meets at 11
Ningpo Road, and that they will attempt to set up a rival
organization.    It is believed that the Students' Union is
behind the new movement.

    The members of various Street Unions in the West Hongkew
District held a meeting at 520 Tsepoo Road, headquarters of
the Tsepoo Road Street Union, at 8 p.m. the 2nd instant to
discuss matters relating to the Stamp Duty.    It was decided
to send a telegram to the Ministry of Finance, Peking, pro-
testing against the levying of Stamp Duty in the Settlement,
and also to communicate with the Amalgamated Association
of Street Unions asking it to deal with the matter.

    The Chinese Police in the City and Chapei were paid
yesterday, the 1st instant.

    M. Paul Painlevé, former French Premier is expected to
□ □ □ tomorrow the 3rd instant.

已致函各马路公会及其他社团，请其派代表参加拟于未来数日内在上述地址举行的会议，以讨论国民大会运动事宜。据悉，中华全国各界联合会会员反对上月21日成立、现于宁波路11号开会的国民大会组织，并试图建立一个与之抗衡的组织。据信，学生联合会是这一新运动背后的支持者。

虹口西区各马路公会成员于本月2日晚8时，在乍浦路马路公会总部乍浦路520号举行会议，讨论有关印花税的事项。会议决定向北京财政部发电抗议在租界内征收印花税，并与各马路公会联合总会联系，请其处理此事。

华界及闸北的中国警察已于昨日（即本月1日）发放薪饷。

法国前总理保罗·潘勒韦（Paul Painlevé）先生预计将于明日（即本月3日）□ □ □。

Sin Wan Pao, 30-8-'20.
Gen. Wu Pae Fu has forwarded the following
letter to the Shanghai Students' Union :-
"Your letter noted. I much appreciate
your admiration. The construction of a building
cannot be completed with a single piece of wood.
So is it in the case of the construction of a
Government, Strength is necessary. The nation
depends upon its people. Should the people
remain indifferent and do not improve their
knowledge, what can they do in constructing
their country. I have long appreciated you
for your patriotism. I hope you will jointly
help in settling all outstanding trouble,
China is suffering from an internal illness -
an outside attack is less important. If steps
are not taken to nurse her, I am afraid that
as soon as she recovers from one illness, she
will be infected with another. Regarding the
unification of the North and South, I have no
fixed opinion as to the solution. What I
desire is to follow the people's wishes and act
righteously."

日期 1920年9月3日

《新闻报》，1920年8月30日。
吴佩孚将军已向上海学生联合会转发如下信函：
“来函收悉。甚感贵方之推崇。独木难支大厦，政府之建设亦然，需凭实力。国家依靠人民。若人民漠不关心且不增进知识，何以建国。吾久已赏识汝等之爱国精神。望汝等共同努力，解决所有遗留问题。中国患有内疾——外患尚属次要。若不加以调治，恐其一病初愈，又染他疾。关于南北统一，吾对解决方案并无定见。吾所愿者，乃顺从民意，行事正义。”

9月3日
(a)
